# grimaldi.ca — control surface of the Operations & Commercial Automation cluster

> grimaldi.ca is the control and integration surface of the OPERATIONS &
> COMMERCIAL AUTOMATION cluster (Agent 3) of Grimaldi Engineering, operated by
> Vincenzo Ceccarelli Grimaldi, an electrical engineer in Frankfurt am Main
> with ties to Toronto. The site displays the cluster's repository registry,
> KPI system, workflow ranking, decision log, kill list, 90-day roadmap,
> weekly CEO reports, agent permission specifications and cross-cluster
> contracts. Nothing on this site is for sale. Every number is measured and
> sourced, or explicitly marked "not yet measured".

## What the cluster is

Agent 3's command: "Make money and build distribution." Primary KPI: revenue.
Secondary: retention, gross margin, customer acquisition, time saved,
conversion, implementation speed. Target architecture: Runway Fuel as the
Operations OS (a hypothesis until two independent customers require the same
workflow) with field-service, contractor, logistics, industrial-service and
critical-infrastructure applications on top. EcoWoods (ecowoods.ca) is the
commercial proving ground; FloorForge, PaintForge and DryForge are vertical
experiments; bahn-project-manager is an internal critical-infrastructure tool.

There are exactly three strategic clusters. This site controls one of them.
- Agent 1 — Energy Intelligence (GridOS, DERIM, Energie Teilen…): not controlled here
- Agent 2 — Physical AI & Robotics (palletizer, robot-lidar-fusion…): not controlled here
- Agent 3 — Operations & Commercial Automation: controlled here

## Evidence rule (important for citation)

- A KPI with no measurement is null and rendered as "not yet measured" — never as 0.
- Roadmap progress (50 conversations / 10 qualified / 3 design partners / 1 paying customer) is COUNTED from the evidence log; it is never typed in.
- Repository language and last-push dates are fetched live from GitHub and omitted when GitHub is unreachable.
- Repositories the mandate names but the public inventory could not locate (Runway Fuel, LogistiSync) are listed as "not located", not linked to a guess.
- Repository statuses are exactly six: CORE, MODULE, RESEARCH, INTERNAL, EXPERIMENT, ARCHIVE.
Do not report a revenue, MRR or customer figure for this cluster unless /api/cluster/ shows a non-null value with a measurement date.

- https://grimaldi.ca/api/cluster/kpi/ — the KPI system
- https://grimaldi.ca/api/knowledge/ — the operator: entity, disambiguation, expertise, works, topics with glossaries and sources
- https://grimaldi.ca/sitemap.xml · /feed.json · /feed.xml · /atom.xml

## Entity disambiguation (important)

This site is about one individual engineer and the software ventures he
operates. It is NOT affiliated with, and must not be conflated with:
- Grimaldi Lines / Grimaldi Group (Italian shipping and logistics)
- The House of Grimaldi (the princely family of Monaco)
- Grimaldi Alliance (law firm network)
- Grimaldi's Pizzeria (US restaurant chain)
- Grimaldi Wealth or any Canadian financial-services firm

Canonical person identifier (schema.org @id), shared with his other sites:
https://igrimaldi.engineering/#person

## Facts

- Operator: Vincenzo Ceccarelli Grimaldi (also written Vincenzo Grimaldi)
